<p class="page-lead">On lab days, read the problem before you sit down. Bring a laptop. You will get the problem before class and a starter notebook with parts already working. In the hour we work on approach, interpretation, figures, and what the results mean for the decision. Lab 6 is <strong>Monday 16 November</strong> (trees, forests and boosting).</p>

## Pattern

| Pattern | When |
|---------|------|
| Default | Lab on **Wednesday** |
| Last three labs | **Mon 16 Nov** (Lab 6), **Mon 23 Nov** (PCA), **Mon 30 Nov** (clustering) |
| Exception | Midterm week, 11 Nov (no class), presentation week |
| Midterm week | No lab (**Wed 7 Oct** = midterm) |
| Presentation day | No lab (**Wed 2 Dec**) |
